t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnoes will appear in pairs e.g orange gnome with a brown gnome. The brightly coloured gnomes such as orange, green, red, blue gnomes will lead to a brighter forest. Gnomes which are brown, pink, yellow and purple will lead to a darker forest. The aim is to collect as many points as possible.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes will appear in pairs for example: Brown with Orange; Green and Pink; Red and Yellow; Blue and Purple.Please note each pair of gnome will lead you to either a dark or bright forest. I realised after playing the game, the bright forest lead me to higher number of mushrooms. The colour of the basket will be either yellow or red. The gnomes which lead me to the bright forest were pink, yellow, brown and purple.The gnomes which lead me to the dark forest were blue, red, orange.Your goal is to collect as many mushrooms as possible. Keep your fingers on the letters K and S and press the space bar.
